observations: Photo 0 shows an industrial plastic bottle making machine with a blue/gray enclosure and a visible control panel area.
No clear brand name, model number, or rating plate text is readable in the photo.
No close-up of key parts (molds/dies, heater section, extruder, gearbox, or electrical specifications) is visible.
No visible PET bottle output, sample bottles, or running/working footage is shown.

identity.kind: automatic plastic bottle making machine (PET bottle)

claims.claim: Automatic Plastic Bottle Making Machine used in production to make pet plastic bottles of different...
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows a plastic bottle making machine, but it does not show PET bottle output, bottle sizes, or any readable production/spec details.

risks.risk: Exact machine type and capacity (blow molding vs other process) and whether it is truly PET bottle capable for the sizes claimed.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the machine nameplate/rating plate (brand, model, voltage, capacity) plus a short video of it running and producing a bottle (showing the bottle size/diameter).
risks.if_unproven: Priced at worst case as a generic plastic bottle making machine with unknown capacity and unproven PET output.

risks.risk: Missing or worn molds/dies (critical for bottle size changes) and whether the machine includes the required mold set(s).
risks.proof: Photos of all molds/dies included (front/back, part numbers if any) and a close-up showing mold condition; also confirm which bottle sizes are included.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not including the correct mold set(s) / unknown mold condition.

risks.risk: Electrical/heating condition (heaters, sensors, control board) and whether it works reliably.
risks.proof: Video start-up and full cycle demonstration; include a close-up of the control panel showing no error codes during operation.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not working / needs testing and possible repairs.

risks.risk: Mechanical wear (extruder/gearbox, bearings, drive system) that may not be visible from the exterior.
risks.proof: Video of operation plus photos of internal wear-prone components if accessible (gearbox/extruder area) and any maintenance records.

risks.risk: Transport readiness and completeness (spares, manuals, tools, and whether it can be installed in Abuja without missing parts).
risks.proof: Checklist photo of included items (manuals, spare parts, tools) and confirmation of what is included; also show connectors/cables and any missing panels.

proof_requests: Clear photo of the machine nameplate/rating plate (brand, model, voltage, power, production capacity).
Short video of the machine running and producing PET bottles (show at least one finished bottle clearly).
Photos of the included molds/dies and confirmation of which bottle sizes are supported.
Video of the control panel during operation showing no error codes.
Photos of key internal components if accessible (extruder/heater/gearbox area) or maintenance records.
response.reason: The photo confirms it is an industrial plastic bottle making machine, but the exact model/capacity, PET capability, included molds, and working condition are not verifiable remotely. Without those, a worst-case price would be unreliable.
